lines.speaker: dagna_holt
lines.text: The ford first. I have too few guards to bury another.
lines.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

lines.speaker: dagna_holt
lines.text: A grey bear is taking goats from the pens, and a fisher's boy is missing. The cave mouth is below Maud's hut on the burned bank. Will you search for him and put an end to the bear?
lines.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

lines.speaker: dagna_holt
lines.text: Bring the ember-claw back. Sixty gold and a fitted trinket each. I will keep gifts for anyone away. Go carefully; that bear has lived through more winters than this Watch.
lines.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

lines.speaker: dagna_holt
lines.text: Then take the time. Cold courage does nobody any good.
lines.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

lines.speaker: dagna_holt
lines.text: Below Maud's hut. Follow the miners' track. Come back with the claw, and with every soul you take in.
lines.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

lines.speaker: dagna_holt
lines.text: Tobin can work with this. Your gold is counted, and there is a rare trinket fitted to each of your callings. Accepting replaces any trinket you already wear. Shall I present them?
lines.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

options.label: Accept the trinkets; replace any worn.
Not yet. Keep the rewards safe.

lines.speaker: dagna_holt
lines.text: They will stay here. A promise does not spoil overnight.
lines.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

lines.speaker: dagna_holt
lines.text: For the ones here, and the ones we expect home. The Watch remembers who stood for this town.
lines.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

lines.speaker: dagna_holt
lines.text: The pens are quiet, and the boy is home with his father. That is enough good news for one day.
lines.direction: Low, flat Northern soldier; restrained gratitude, no ceremony.

lines.speaker: dagna_holt
lines.text: The bridge is ours. I keep seeing the old woman fall. There's work on the notice board. I'd rather you were busy.

lines.speaker: dagna_holt
lines.text: Peace with the clan. Half my guards think I've gone soft. The notice board has work, if you want something to hit.
